n: ὑμῖν (humin) 'to you' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἡμεῖς (hēmeis) 'we ourselves' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἐπαγγελία (epangelia) 'promise' occurs in a few manuscripts (TR) instead of ἀγγελία (angelia) 'message' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz+KJV)
Χριστοῦ (Christou) 'Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Ἀδελφοί (Adelphoi) 'brothers' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Ἀγαπητοί, (Agapētoi) 'Beloved,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς. (ap᾽ archēs) 'from beginning.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
πάντα (panta) 'all things' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of πάντες. (pantes) 'all [you].' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)
οὐν (oun) 'therefore' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ὅταν (hotan) 'when' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἐὰν (ean) 'if' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
καὶ ἐσμέν. (kai esmen) 'and we are!' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ὑμᾶς (humas) 'you' occurs in a few manuscripts (Byz) instead of ἡμᾶς, (hēmas) 'us,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+TR)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
μου, (mou) 'of mine' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
τὸν ἀδελφόν (ton adelphon) 'the brother' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
μου, (mou) 'of mine' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
γινώσκεται (ginōsketai) 'it is known' occurs in a few manuscripts (Byz) instead of γινώσκετε (ginōskete) 'you know' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+TR)
Χριστὸν ἐν σαρκὶ ἐληλυθότα (Christon en sarki elēluthota) 'Christ in flesh having come' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
μένει. (menei) 'abides.' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Byz)
αὐτόν, (auton) 'him' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
πῶς (pōs) 'how' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of οὐ (ou) 'not' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)

ἕν τῷ οὐρανῷ ὁ πατήρ ὁ λόγος καὶ τὸ ἅγιον πνεῦμα καὶ οὗτοι οἱ τρεῖς ἕν εἰσιν (hen tō ouranō ho patēr ho logos kai to hagion pneuma kai houtoi hoi treis hen eisin) 'in the heaven the Father the Word and the Holy Spirit and these three one are' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
καὶ τρεῖς εἰσιν οἱ μαρτυροῦντες ἕν τῇ γῇ, (kai treis eisin hoi marturountes hen tēa gēa) 'and three are those bearing testimony in the earth: ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
τοῖς πιστεύουσιν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ, (tois pisteuousin eis to onoma tou huiou tou theou) 'to those believing into the name of the Son of God' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καὶ ἵνα (kai ina) 'and so that' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἀμήν.¶ (amēn) 'Amen.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
